morbi.headline: Morbi faces severe export contraction alongside recurring domestic trade credit defaults and fraud.
what_changed: India's ceramic tile export volumes plunged 46% during April-July 2026, leading to a weak full-year FY27 export outlook.
Multiple buyer fraud incidents emerged, exposing manufacturers to unsecured trade credit defaults in the domestic market.
stress_signals: Export volumes dropped 46% year-on-year in Apr-Jul 2026, severely dampening the FY27 demand outlook for ceramic tile makers [434975bd08e0].
A Mumbai-based buyer allegedly defrauded a Morbi ceramic unit of Rs 44 lakh after procuring tiles on credit [e694c857f915].
A buyer absconded after securing 7,865 ceramic tile boxes on credit, reflecting recurring unsecured payment defaults in the cluster [76fdd3301f32].
what_to_watch: Full-year FY27 export trajectory and subsequent export volume prints following the 46% drop in Apr-Jul 2026.
Elongation of debtor collection cycles and rising non-payment/fraud risks on unsecured domestic credit sales.
Working capital utilization and cash flow stress in export-focused tile manufacturing units facing volume drops.

surat.headline: Surat faces yarn price hikes, embroidery labour unrest, and diamond export declines.
what_changed: Looms face threats of closing 15 days early before Diwali driven by a ₹50/kg yarn price hike and a broader 45% surge.
Embroidery sector operations are severely constrained by a 3-month impasse, worker agitations, legal disputes, and over 80 worker detentions.
Textile labour strikes sparked migrant exodus to UP and Bihar, while diamond exports registered a 7% drop in polished shipments.
stress_signals: Loom units face early Diwali closure amid a ₹50/kg (up to 45%) yarn price surge [b567711c9ed4, 1b54f570ed7b].
Embroidery sector gripped by a three-month deadlock, 50 workers quitting, and over 80 detentions during wage and holiday protests [e7921383cbb7, af8a29b318b7, 7697e96a190e, 6b7974c7f88e].
Surat diamond exports dropped 7% alongside reports of trader defaults on polishing wages [975918f112f3, 698c779932f2].
Credit and counterparty risks flagged via a ₹10.14 crore textile fraud arrest, a ₹29.57 lakh grey fabric default, and multiple cheating complaints [2514ad7d6e20, c4997bb35d98, 2718cba9f837].
improvement_signals: GST Council granted Input Tax Credit (ITC) refunds and eased highway checks for Surat textiles [17f0a015a73c].
Central government initiated a study of the Surat textile hub to formulate a national policy [a3db8ea1103a].
TEJAS Association, representing 35,000 loom machine owners, publicly denied operational shutdown rumors [1a925ede03e9].
what_to_watch: Loom operating days and capacity utilization before Diwali following yarn price inflation and FOB rate applications.
Embroidery segment debt-service metrics, machine-loan DPBs, and potential resolutions to labor union agitations.
Liquidity flow from GST ITC refund disbursements to offset rising grey fabric counterparty risks.
Export volumes and collections in polished diamonds and LGD segments amidst UK advertising regulatory scrutiny.
